title: Royal Roller Ruckus — Crownway Circuit
description: A 2–10 racer momentum cage race across Crownway, Frostglass, Foundry and Skygarden, with live bot title races, warned hazards, course practice, a four-course Series, seeded replay, scoped records and extensive player/access preferences.

source.provenance: Imported user-supplied original preserved unchanged. Active v1.6.0 adds four courses, isolated live bot title, practice/Series, seeded replay, customization and licensed local Kenney scenery. Existing Three r180 engine and classic physics retained. Official matching MIT GLTFLoader/utilities use local import paths only; no runtime CDN.
